thread:
marta: noticed several tenants show preview quota drop after edge-router rollout (02:03 UTC). ledger looks fine.

leo: looking: preview stream shows increments where x-edge-region header present twice -> two entries emitted per request.

gabi: quick log: `emit_preview(tenant=t-88, req=0x1a, region=us-east)` then `emit_preview(tenant=t-88, req=0x1a, region=us-east)` identical. upstream router started duplicating header for failover.

infra-bot: alert: preview.duplicate_headers rate=12 for tenant t-88

marta: is this preview-only? final ledger dedupes on (req,tenant) after normalization.

leo: correct, final ledger unaffected. preview-agg dedupe key uses the entire header blob so double header created distinct fingerprints.

devex: UX: we should avoid showing negative available to customers. Propose a temporary console flag per org "suppress-preview" and a banner: "Preview counts may be inflated due to recent edge rollout."

gabi: mitigation: patch preview-agg to normalize duplicate headers by collapsing to unique set before fingerprinting. small change. Also widen dedupe window to 45s during rollout.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0319-514 created; owners: marta (owner), gabi (patch), leo (recompute), devex (console flag).

marta: timeline? gabi can PR in 90m. I'll enable console suppress flag for top affected tenants now.

gabi: PR will include unit test collapsing headers and an integration sim for duplicate header arrival order.

leo: recompute job planned for 02:00-02:30 window after patch. will diff preview vs ledger and post results.

marta: thanks. adding postmortem item: edge-router rollouts must validate header fingerprint compatibility with preview pipeline.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0319-514 status -> in_progress
